markets.market: EXAMPLE: Will Fictional City approve its new transit budget by Dec 31?
markets.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if the city council records a passing vote on the budget before 2026-12-31 23:59 UTC.

evidence_yes.claim: Council majority publicly said they support the budget

evidence_no.claim: Two members asked for a delay

unknowns: Whether the vote gets scheduled before the holiday recess

markets.market: EXAMPLE: Will Fictional Corp ship product X this quarter?
markets.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if product X is generally available before 2026-12-31.

markets.market: EXAMPLE: Will Fictional League match be postponed?
markets.resolution_criteria: Resolves YES if the league officially postpones the match.

evidence_yes.claim: Official league notice: stadium inspection failed
Teams told to prepare alternate venue

evidence_no.claim: League says alternate venue is possible instead of postponing

unknowns: Whether an alternate venue counts as no postponement
